build_GPT2Tokenizer_from_pretrained: build a GPT2Tokenizer from pretrained model name or path using from_pretrained class method
create_GPT2Tokenizer_tokenize: create BPE tokens from a text string using the GPT2Tokenizer tokenize method
run_GPT2Tokenizer_encode_decode: run encode to convert text to token IDs and decode to convert token IDs back to text
test_GPT2Tokenizer_convert_tokens_to_ids: test the GPT2Tokenizer convert_tokens_to_ids method to map a list of tokens to their vocabulary IDs
save_GPT2Tokenizer_vocabulary: save the GPT2Tokenizer vocabulary merges and special tokens files to a directory using save_vocabulary
